overview.en:
Search projects and tasks, review workload and organize team work and follow-ups with Wrike.

Review project work with the relevant tasks, owners, and deadlines in view. Turn the available records into a status summary or a reviewable plan for the next iteration.

Complete the connection or local-runtime setup described by this plugin before using service tools. Results depend on the tools exposed to your account; specify the target resource and report scope when starting a task.
overview.zh-CN:
使用 Wrike 搜索项目与任务、查看工作进展，整理团队协作和后续待办。

结合任务、负责人和截止日期查看项目工作，将可用记录整理成进度摘要或下一阶段的待审阅计划。

使用服务工具前，按插件说明完成连接或本地运行环境配置。结果取决于账号可用工具；开始任务时请说明目标资源与报告范围。

starterPrompts.en: Summarize this project's current progress and outstanding work.
starterPrompts.zh-CN: 汇总这个项目的当前进展与未完成事项。

starterPrompts.en: Review tasks due this week and identify dependencies or missing owners.
starterPrompts.zh-CN: 查看本周到期任务，识别依赖或缺少负责人的事项。

starterPrompts.en: Prepare a project status update based on the available records.
starterPrompts.zh-CN: 根据可用记录准备项目进度更新。

descriptions.en: Use Wrike in Ghast. Search projects and tasks, review workload and organize team work and follow-ups with Wrike. 使用 Wrike 搜索项目与任务、查看工作进展，整理团队协作和后续待办。
